Permits & License Committee  April 10, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 5

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 10, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on April 10, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Christine Rivera , Planning Department- on behalf of (Chair)
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Synaelyn Thomas, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Christine Rivera – on behalf of (Chair) asked if there were any persons present who wished to address
the Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Christine Rivera – on behalf of (Chair) reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on March 27, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Jose Juan Torres on behalf of Northgate Market to host a Mother’s Day Flower Sale Event
  at 10801 S Prairie Ave;on Friday, May 09, 2025; Saturday, May 10, 2025; Sunday, May 11,
  2025; Private Property, from 7:00 a.m. -8:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval
  for 3 day event within Northgate Market parking lot; Applicant responsible for crowd control,
  event clean up, and all applicable mitigation measures; Approved; Applicant to ensure traffic
  safety measures (plan) are in place in the parking lot where this event is expected to take
  place; NO vehicular traffic where customers will be walking in the sales event area. Applicant
  to hire adequate security guards for the safety of attendees. IPD watch commander will be
  notified and extra patrol; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional
  recommendations for Fire approval; ; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00405336)

Item #2:  Aila Hernandez on behalf of Kaiser Permanente West Los Angeles to host a KP Diabetes
  Mobile Clinic Event at 10801 S Prairie Ave; on Thursday, April 24, 2024 Private Property,
  from 2:00 p. m. – 7:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for one (1) day event
  within Northgate Market parking lot;. Applicant to hire adequate professional-licensed
  security guards for the safety of attendees; IPD approved metal barriers in the parking lot;
  IPD will staff two (2) police officers to this event for public safety; IPD watch commander
  will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time permit; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health
  Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County,
  and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.; Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405343)
New Business License Request (s):

Item #3:  Qazi Shah on behalf of Eagle Car Rental to operate as Auto Rent / Lease at 1009 W Arbor
  Vitae St. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your license renewal;All vehicles
  must be registered with DMV; NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs / maintenance
  on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site at all times;Business owner and all employees shall have a valid and current
  government-issued identification in their possession at all times; Subject to random
  inspections by any City of Inglewood Code Enforcement or Police Officer or DMV
  Investigators at any time to ensure compliance; andAdhere to all State, Federal and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application requests.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405273)

Item #4:  Patsy Ngoc on behalf of Patsy Nails Salon to operate as Hair / Nail Salon at 1713
  Centinela Ave; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City;
  Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies
  of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type
  is strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the
  body is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer
  or any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and

Item #5:  Fernando Loyola on behalf of Primo VP to operate as a Parking Lot at 10417 S Prairie Ave;
  APPROVED  CONDITIONALLY  SUBJECT  TO  THE  FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed

  Parking attendant or security guard must be on site during event parking at all times;Ensure
  safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site and;Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405068)

New Tobacco License Renewal Request (s):

Item #7:  High Noon Market to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 3301 W Imperial Hwy This
  Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition set forth by the
  Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes
  (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES
  ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and
  Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet of total retail floor
  area Sales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-
  Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges,
  Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless
  Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco,
  Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andhe following is not allowed inside
